title: Derived descent of already constructed strict signed tensor shifts
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l and a scheme W in the same universe. For any signed Roos shift rho on the completed coefficient module category satisfying both coordinate laws [def-pod-completion-reindex-models], there exist derived left and right shift fields L,R such that podTensorSignedShiftOfDerived l E W L R [def-pod-tensor-signed-shift-towers] satisfies Model l E rho [def-pod-completion-reindex-shifts]. Thus every representative equation uses the already fixed strict tower maps and the supplied rho, for every good P,Q and every compatible presentation eP,eQ,ePprime,eQprime,a,b. This theorem constructs no finite or strict tower shift data and does not assert the finite generator calculation.

source.place: Steps 1 and 5; signed shifts of the same representative-normalized tensor operation. Supporting calculation: Stacks homology.tex, definition-shift-cochain, and more-algebra.tex, item-shift-tensor; descent: sites-cohomology.tex, lemma-pullback-tensor-product.

proof.text: On pairs of good representatives compose the tensor representative comparison, the fixed strict shift map, the supplied signed Roos comparison, the localization shift and the inverse shifted tensor representative comparison. The finite summand formulas prove naturality in both representatives. Naturality of rho follows by testing its two cone coordinates using its laws. Fully faithful precomposition by the product good-complex localization extends these natural isomorphisms uniquely to the derived tensor. Precompose with arbitrary shifted-input identifications and apply naturality to all four presentation isomorphisms. The two compatibility hypotheses in Model identify those isomorphisms with the localization shift, yielding both displayed equations.

theorem podTensorSignedShiftDescent (W : Scheme.{u})
    (ρ : PodSignedRoosShift (scalarReductionSource l E W)) (hρ : ρ.Laws) :

      (podTensorSignedShiftOfDerived l E W L R).Model l E ρ
